Captive strength becomes defiance. Worn hide drums, low bowed strings with audible bow grain, sparse muted iron and bronze rattle. A clear middle-register bowed-string melody is the emotional spine, supported by tactile interlocking percussion. Proposed D Dorian centre. Preserve physical restraint and dramatic entrance; melody must remain audible through the percussion.

Begin on the first downbeat with one deep hide-drum strike and a tense bowed-string attack. In six bars, reveal a short rising three-note bowed motif answered by a falling fourth. Leave breath between drum strokes. End bar six on a held open fifth ready for the theme.

State the complete bowed-string melody over restrained interlocking hide drums in bars seven to twelve. Repeat its identity with a changed answering contour in bars thirteen to eighteen, introducing one dry iron rattle at the phrase boundary. Keep the tune prominent and the texture human.
acoustic hide percussion and bowed low strings

At bar nineteen, open into the first full physical statement: drums interlock beneath the same melody in a higher register. At bar twenty-five, pass its answer to low strings and invert only the final interval. Increase movement without adding a new tune. Both six-bar phrases end on clear edit boundaries.
acoustic hide percussion and bowed low strings

At bar thirty-one, remove half the percussion and expose the theme over a held lower neighbour. Bow grain and close string suspensions carry unease. At bar thirty-seven, rebuild with a slowly tightening hide-drum pattern; sustain harmonic pressure without accelerating the tempo or adding a riser.
acoustic hide percussion and bowed low strings

At bar forty-three, bring back the complete melody in strong bowed octaves above the fullest hide rhythm. Let the phrase breathe between attacks. At bar forty-nine, answer with the widest modal harmony and one restrained iron accent. This is the emotional peak, not a wall of noise.
acoustic hide percussion and bowed low strings

At bar fifty-five, withdraw the upper percussion and return the opening motif to one exposed bowed voice. Resolve the tension across six bars with a final grounded open fifth. Let drum skin and bow resonance decay naturally inside the last bar; complete ending by 150 seconds.
